concept.name: Pythagoras' theorem
concept.subject: Maths
concept.prompt_text: In a right-angled triangle, the longest side is called the hypotenuse. The square of the hypotenuse is equal to the sum of the squares of the other two sides: a² + b² = c².

svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="100%" height="100%">
    <title>Pythagorean Theorem Animation</title>
    
    <style>
        .bg { fill: #ffffff; }
        .grid { stroke: #f0f0f0; stroke-width: 1; }
        .triangle { fill: rgba(52, 152, 219, 0.2); stroke: #2980b9; stroke-width: 4; stroke-linejoin: round; }
        .square-a { fill: rgba(231, 76, 60, 0.7); stroke: #c0392b; stroke-width: 3; }
        .square-b { fill: rgba(46, 204, 113, 0.7); stroke: #27ae60; stroke-width: 3; }
        .square-c { fill: rgba(155, 89, 182, 0.7); stroke: #8e44ad; stroke-width: 3; }
        .label { font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 24px; font-weight: bold; fill: #2c3e50; text-anchor: middle; dominant-baseline: middle; }
        .title { font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 30px; font-weight: bold; fill: #2c3e50; text-anchor: middle; }
        .formula { font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 32px; font-weight: bold; fill: #e74c3c; text-anchor: middle; }
        .formula-b { fill: #27ae60; }
        .formula-c { fill: #8e44ad; }
        .right-angle { fill: none; stroke: #2980b9; stroke-width: 3; }
        
        @keyframes pulse {
            0% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 0.8; }
            50% { transform: scale(1.02); opacity: 1; }
            100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 0.8; }
        }
        
        @keyframes fadeInOut {
            0% { opacity: 0.4; }
            50% { opacity: 1; }
            100% { opacity: 0.4; }
        }

        .animated-sq {
            animation: pulse 4s infinite ease-in-out;
            transform-origin: center;
        }
        
        .highlight-text {
            animation: fadeInOut 3s infinite ease-in-out;
        }
    </style>

    <!-- Background -->
    <rect class="bg" width="800" height="600" />
    
    <!-- Title & Formula -->
    <text x="400" y="45" class="title">The Pythagorean Theorem</text>
    <text x="400" y="560" class="formula">
        <tspan class="formula-a">a²</tspan> + 
        <tspan class="formula-b">b²</tspan> = 
        <tspan class="formula-c">c²</tspan>
    </text>

    <!-- 
      Triangle Coordinates:
      A (bottom-left): 300, 400
      B (bottom-right): 500, 400  (dx = 200)
      C (top-left): 300, 250      (dy = -150)
      
      Side a (vertical): from (300,250) to (300,400) -> length 150
      Side b (horizontal): from (300,400) to (500,400) -> length 200
      Side c (hypotenuse): from (300,250) to (500,400) -> length 250 (sqrt(150^2 + 200^2))
    -->

    <!-- Squares on sides -->
    <!-- Square A (left, 150x150, built outwards to the left: x from 150 to 300, y from 250 to 400) -->
    <rect x="150" y="250" width="150" height="150" class="square-a animated-sq" />
    
    <!-- Square B (bottom, 200x200, built outwards downwards: x from 300 to 500, y from 400 to 600 - wait, y=600 is edge, let's adjust triangle positions up slightly) -->
    <!-- Let's shift the whole diagram up by 50px:
         A: 300, 350
         B: 500, 350
         C: 300, 200
         Side a = 150 (height)
         Side b = 200 (width)
    -->
    
    <!-- RE-CALCULATED POSITIONS (Shifted Up):
         A = (300, 350)
         B = (500, 350)
         C = (300, 200)
    -->

    <g transform="translate(0, -30)">
        <!-- Square A (left, 150x150, extends left from x=150 to 300, y=200 to 350) -->
        <rect x="150" y="200" width="150" height="150" class="square-a animated-sq" />
        <text x="225" y="275" class="label" fill="white">a²</text>

        <!-- Square B (bottom, 200x200, extends down from y=350 to 550, x=300 to 500) -->
        <rect x="300" y="350" width="200" height="200" class="square-b animated-sq" />
        <text x="400" y="450" class="label" fill="white">b²</text>

        <!-- Square C (Hypotenuse, 250x250 rotated)
             Vector for hypotenuse: from (300, 200) to (500, 350) -> dx = 200, dy = 150.
             Perpendicular vector pointing outwards (up-right/top-left relative to angle): (-150, 200).
             Let's use exact polygon points for Square C built outwards from hypotenuse (300,200 to 500,350):
             P1: (300, 200)
             P2: (500, 350)
             P3: (500 + 150, 350 + 200) = (650, 550) -> wait, let's check direction.
             Vector v = (200, 150). Perpendicular vector perp = (-150, 200).
             If we add perp to P2 and P1:
             Corner 3: (500 - 150, 350 + 200) = (350, 550) -> overlaps triangle. We need it outwards (up-left).
             Outwards perp = (150, -200).
             P_top1 = P1 + (150, -200) = (450, 0)
             P_top2 = P2 + (150, -200) = (650, 150)
             Let's verify: 
             P1(300,200) -> P2(500,350) -> P_top2(650,150) -> P_top1(450,0) -> P1(300,200).
        -->
        <polygon points="300,200 500,350 650,150 450,0" class="square-c animated-sq" />
        <text x="525" y="175" class="label" fill="white">c²</text>

        <!-- Triangle -->
        <polygon points="300,200 300,350 500,350" class="triangle" />

        <!-- Right angle marker -->
        <polyline points="300,330 320,330 320,350" class="right-angle" />

        <!-- Side Labels -->
        <text x="270" y="275" class="label" style="fill: #c0392b;">a</text>
        <text x="400" y="380" class="label" style="fill: #27ae60;">b</text>
        <text x="420" y="260" class="label" style="fill: #8e44ad;">Hypotenuse (c)</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Educational Callout / Legend -->
    <g transform="translate(580, 200)">
        <rect x="0" y="0" width="190" height="150" rx="10" fill="#f8f9fa" stroke="#bdc3c7" stroke-width="2"/>
        <text x="95" y="30" class="label" style="font-size: 18px;">Quick Facts</text>
        <circle cx="20" cy="65" r="8" fill="#e74c3c" />
        <text x="40" y="70" class="label" style="font-size: 14px; text-anchor: start;">Side a = 3 units</text>
        <circle cx="20" cy="100" r="8" fill="#2ecc71" />
        <text x="40" y="105" class="label" style="font-size: 14px; text-anchor: start;">Side b = 4 units</text>
        <circle cx="20" cy="135" r="8" fill="#9b59b6" />
        <text x="40" y="140" class="label" style="font-size: 14px; text-anchor: start;">Hypotenuse c = 5</text>
    </g>

</svg>

concept.name: Parts of a circle
concept.subject: Maths
concept.prompt_text: A circle has a centre. The radius is the distance from the centre to the edge. The diameter goes across the circle through the centre and is twice the radius. The circumference is the distance around the circle.

svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="100%" height="100%">
    <title>Circle Geometry: Centre, Radius, Diameter, and Circumference</title>
    
    <style>
        .bg { fill: #ffffff; }
        .circle-base { fill: #f0f7ff; stroke: #2c3e50; stroke-width: 4; }
        .center-point { fill: #e74c3c; }
        .radius-line { stroke: #27ae60; stroke-width: 4; stroke-dasharray: 8,6; }
        .diameter-line { stroke: #2980b9; stroke-width: 4; }
        .circumference-path { fill: none; stroke: #8e44ad; stroke-width: 6; stroke-dasharray: 1000; stroke-dashoffset: 1000; animation: drawCircumference 4s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
        
        .label { font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: bold; fill: #2c3e50; }
        .title { font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 28px; font-weight: bold; fill: #2c3e50; text-anchor: middle; }
        .desc { font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; fill: #7f8c8d; text-anchor: middle; }
        
        .radius-label { fill: #27ae60; }
        .diameter-label { fill: #2980b9; }
        .circumference-label { fill: #8e44ad; }
        
        @keyframes drawCircumference {
            0% { stroke-dashoffset: 1000; }
            50%, 100% { stroke-dashoffset: 0; }
        }
        
        @keyframes pulse {
            0% { r: 6; }
            50% { r: 9; }
            100% { r: 6; }
        }
        
        .pulse-center { animation: pulse 2s infinite; }
    </style>

    <!-- Background -->
    <rect class="bg" width="100%" height="100%" />

    <!-- Title and Subtitle -->
    <text x="400" y="45" class="title">Anatomy of a Circle</text>
    <text x="400" y="75" class="desc">Visualizing Centre, Radius, Diameter, and Circumference</text>

    <!-- Main Circle Group (Centered at 300, 350 with radius 160) -->
    <g transform="translate(300, 350)">
        <!-- Base Circle -->
        <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="160" class="circle-base" />
        
        <!-- Circumference Animated Highlight -->
        <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="160" class="circumference-path" />

        <!-- Diameter Line (Horizontal from left edge to right edge through center) -->
        <line x1="-160" y1="0" x2="160" y2="0" class="diameter-line" />

        <!-- Radius Line (From center to top-right edge) -->
        <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="113.14" y2="-113.14" class="radius-line" />

        <!-- Center Point -->
        <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="6" class="center-point pulse-center" />

    <!-- Side Panel for Definitions & Labels -->
    <g transform="translate(520, 180)">

        <circle cx="20" cy="20" r="6" class="center-point" />
        <text x="45" y="27" class="label">Centre</text>
        <text x="45" y="50" class="desc" text-anchor="start">The exact middle point</text>

        <!-- Radius Label -->
        <line x1="10" y1="100" x2="30" y2="100" class="radius-line" />
        <text x="45" y="107" class="label radius-label">Radius ($r$)</text>
        <text x="45" y="130" class="desc" text-anchor="start">Centre to the edge</text>

        <!-- Diameter Label -->
        <line x1="10" y1="180" x2="30" y2="180" class="diameter-line" />
        <text x="45" y="187" class="label diameter-label">Diameter ($d$)</text>
        <text x="45" y="210" class="desc" text-anchor="start">Across edge-to-edge ($2 \times r$)</text>

        <!-- Circumference Label -->
        <path d="M 10,260 A 10,10 0 0,1 30,260" fill="none" stroke="#8e44ad" stroke-width="4" />
        <text x="45" y="267" class="label circumference-label">Circumference ($C$)</text>
        <text x="45" y="290" class="desc" text-anchor="start">Distance around the circle</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Direct Diagram Labels -->
    <text x="315" y="340" class="label" fill="#e74c3c">Centre</text>
    <text x="385" y="275" class="label radius-label">Radius</text>
    <text x="210" y="335" class="label diameter-label">Diameter</text>
    <text x="110" y="220" class="label circumference-label">Circumference</text>

</svg>

concept.name: Series circuit
concept.subject: Physics
concept.prompt_text: In a series circuit there is only one loop. The current is the same everywhere in the loop. The voltage of the cell is shared between the components.

svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600">
  <title>Series Circuit Concepts</title>
  
  <style>
    .bg { fill: #ffffff; }
    .wire { fill: none; stroke: #2c3e50; stroke-width: 4; stroke-linejoin: round; }
    .component { fill: #ffffff; stroke: #2c3e50; stroke-width: 3; rx: 6; }
    .label { font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; fill: #2c3e50; font-weight: bold; }
    .sublabel { font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; fill: #7f8c8d; }
    .title { font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 22px; fill: #2c3e50; font-weight: bold; text-anchor: middle; }
    .bullet { font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; fill: #34495e; }
    
    /* Animation for current flow */
    .electron { fill: #e74c3c; animation: moveElectron 4s linear infinite; }
    
    @keyframes moveElectron {
      0% { offset-distance: 0%; }
      100% { offset-distance: 100%; }
    }
    
    .path-track {
      fill: none;
      stroke: none;
      d: path("M 200 350 L 200 200 L 600 200 L 600 350 L 600 500 L 200 500 Z");
    }
  </style>

  <rect width="100%" height="100%" class="bg" />

  <!-- Title -->
  <text x="400" y="45" class="title">Series Circuit: Single Loop</text>

  <!-- Explanation Panel -->
  <rect x="150" y="70" width="500" height="90" rx="8" fill="#f8f9fa" stroke="#bdc3c7" stroke-width="1" />
  <text x="170" y="100" class="bullet">• One single continuous loop for current.</text>
  <text x="170" y="125" class="bullet">• Current ($I$) is the same everywhere.</text>
  <text x="170" y="150" class="bullet">• Voltage ($V_{cell}$) is shared across components ($V_1 + V_2$).</text>

  <!-- Circuit Wires -->
  <path d="M 200 370 L 200 220 L 600 220 L 600 370" class="wire" />
  <path d="M 600 430 L 600 480 L 200 480 L 200 430" class="wire" />

  <!-- Cell / Battery (Left) -->
  <g transform="translate(175, 370)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="50" height="60" class="component" />
    <line x1="15" y1="15" x2="35" y2="15" stroke="#2c3e50" stroke-width="4" />
    <line x1="22" y1="25" x2="28" y2="25" stroke="#2c3e50" stroke-width="2" />
    <line x1="15" y1="35" x2="35" y2="35" stroke="#2c3e50" stroke-width="4" />
    <line x1="22" y1="45" x2="28" y2="45" stroke="#2c3e50" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="55" y="20" class="label">+</text>
    <text x="57" y="50" class="label">-</text>
  </g>
  <text x="135" y="410" class="label">Cell</text>
  <text x="110" y="430" class="sublabel">Voltage ($V$) shared</text>

  <!-- Resistor 1 (Top) -->
  <g transform="translate(370, 205)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="60" height="30" class="component" />
    <!-- Resistor zig-zag symbol inside -->
    <path d="M 10 15 L 15 5 L 25 25 L 35 5 L 45 25 L 50 15" fill="none" stroke="#2c3e50" stroke-width="2" />
  </g>
  <text x="375" y="195" class="label">Resistor 1</text>
  <text x="370" y="260" class="sublabel">Voltage $V_1$</text>

  <!-- Resistor 2 (Right) -->
  <g transform="translate(575, 370)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="50" height="60" class="component" />
    <!-- Vertical Resistor symbol -->
    <path d="M 25 10 L 15 15 L 35 25 L 15 35 L 35 45 L 25 50" fill="none" stroke="#2c3e50" stroke-width="2" />
  </g>
  <text x="640" y="405" class="label">Resistor 2</text>
  <text x="640" y="425" class="sublabel">Voltage $V_2$</text>

  <!-- Invisible path for motion reference matching the circuit loop -->
  <path id="motionPath" class="path-track" d="M 200 350 L 200 220 L 600 220 L 600 350 L 600 480 L 200 480 Z" />

  <!-- Animated Current (Electrons) -->
  <circle r="6" class="electron">
    <animateMotion dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite">
      <mpath href="#motionPath" />
    </animateMotion>
  </circle>

  <circle r="6" class="electron">
    <animateMotion dur="4s" begin="1.33s" repeatCount="indefinite">
      <mpath href="#motionPath" />
    </animateMotion>
  </circle>

  <circle r="6" class="electron">
    <animateMotion dur="4s" begin="2.66s" repeatCount="indefinite">
      <mpath href="#motionPath" />
    </animateMotion>
  </circle>

  <!-- Current label -->
  <text x="370" y="520" class="label" text-anchor="middle">Current ($I$) is identical at all points</text>
  <text x="400" y="545" class="sublabel" text-anchor="middle">(Red dots represent electron flow / current)</text>

</svg>

concept.name: Photosynthesis
concept.subject: Biology
concept.prompt_text: Plants take in carbon dioxide and water. They use light energy, absorbed by chlorophyll, to make glucose and oxygen.

  <style>

  <text x="760" y="426" text-anchor="middle" class="label-text">Glucose</text>
  <text x="760" y="446" text-anchor="middle" class="sub-text">Plant Food (C₆H₁₂O₆)</text>

concept.name: States of matter
concept.subject: Chemistry
concept.prompt_text: In a solid the particles are close together and vibrate in place. In a liquid they are close but move past each other. In a gas they are far apart and move fast.

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 900 600" width="100%" height="100%">
  <title>States of Matter: Solid, Liquid, and Gas Particle Motion</title>
  
  <style>
    /* Background and containers */
    .bg { fill: #ffffff; }
    .container-box { fill: #f8fafc; stroke: #cbd5e1; stroke-width: 3; rx: 12; }
    .label { font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 22px; font-weight: bold; fill: #1e293b; text-anchor: middle; }
    .sublabel { font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; fill: #64748b; text-anchor: middle; }
    .title { font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 28px; font-weight: bold; fill: #0f172a; text-anchor: middle; }
    
    /* Particles */
    .particle { stroke: #1e40af; stroke-width: 2; }
    .solid-p { fill: #3b82f6; }
    .liquid-p { fill: #0ea5e9; }
    .gas-p { fill: #6366f1; }

    /* Animations */
    @keyframes vibrate {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      20% { transform: translate(-2px, 2px); }
      40% { transform: translate(2px, -2px); }
      60% { transform: translate(-1px, -2px); }
      80% { transform: translate(2px, 1px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }

    @keyframes flow1 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      25% { transform: translate(12px, -8px); }
      50% { transform: translate(-8px, 12px); }
      75% { transform: translate(10px, 10px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }

    @keyframes flow2 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      25% { transform: translate(-15px, 10px); }
      50% { transform: translate(10px, 15px); }
      75% { transform: translate(-10px, -10px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }

    @keyframes flow3 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      25% { transform: translate(10px, 12px); }
      50% { transform: translate(-12px, -10px); }
      75% { transform: translate(15px, -5px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }

    @keyframes fly1 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      20% { transform: translate(-80px, -60px); }
      40% { transform: translate(70px, -90px); }
      60% { transform: translate(-50px, 80px); }
      80% { transform: translate(90px, 50px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }

    @keyframes fly2 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      20% { transform: translate(90px, 70px); }
      40% { transform: translate(-60px, -80px); }
      60% { transform: translate(80px, -40px); }
      80% { transform: translate(-90px, 60px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }

    @keyframes fly3 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      20% { transform: translate(-70px, 90px); }
      40% { transform: translate(80px, 60px); }
      60% { transform: translate(-90px, -70px); }
      80% { transform: translate(50px, -90px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }

    /* Applying animations to group elements */
    .v-1 { animation: vibrate 0.3s infinite ease-in-out; }
    .v-2 { animation: vibrate 0.25s infinite ease-in-out; animation-delay: 0.1s; }
    .v-3 { animation: vibrate 0.35s infinite ease-in-out; animation-delay: 0.2s; }

    .f-1 { animation: flow1 4s infinite ease-in-out; }
    .f-2 { animation: flow2 3.5s infinite ease-in-out; }
    .f-3 { animation: flow3 4.5s infinite ease-in-out; }

    .g-1 { animation: fly1 2s infinite linear; }
    .g-2 { animation: fly2 2.3s infinite linear; }
    .g-3 { animation: fly3 1.8s infinite linear; }
  </style>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect class="bg" width="100%" height="100%" />

  <!-- Main Title -->
  <text x="450" y="45" class="title">States of Matter & Particle Motion</text>

  <!-- ================= SOLID ================= -->
  <g transform="translate(50, 80)">
    <rect class="container-box" x="0" y="0" width="240" height="420" />
    <text x="120" y="40" class="label">Solid</text>
    <text x="120" y="65" class="sublabel">Close together, vibrating</text>
    
    <!-- Lattice of 16 particles -->
    <!-- Row 1 -->
    <g class="v-1"><circle class="particle solid-p" cx="60" cy="120" r="14"/></g>
    <g class="v-2"><circle class="particle solid-p" cx="100" cy="120" r="14"/></g>
    <g class="v-3"><circle class="particle solid-p" cx="140" cy="120" r="14"/></g>
    <g class="v-1"><circle class="particle solid-p" cx="180" cy="120" r="14"/></g>
    <!-- Row 2 -->
    <g class="v-2"><circle class="particle solid-p" cx="60" cy="160" r="14"/></g>
    <g class="v-3"><circle class="particle solid-p" cx="100" cy="160" r="14"/></g>
    <g class="v-1"><circle class="particle solid-p" cx="140" cy="160" r="14"/></g>
    <g class="v-2"><circle class="particle solid-p" cx="180" cy="160" r="14"/></g>
    <!-- Row 3 -->
    <g class="v-3"><circle class="particle solid-p" cx="60" cy="200" r="14"/></g>
    <g class="v-1"><circle class="particle solid-p" cx="100" cy="200" r="14"/></g>
    <g class="v-2"><circle class="particle solid-p" cx="140" cy="200" r="14"/></g>
    <g class="v-3"><circle class="particle solid-p" cx="180" cy="200" r="14"/></g>
    <!-- Row 4 -->
    <g class="v-1"><circle class="particle solid-p" cx="60" cy="240" r="14"/></g>
    <g class="v-2"><circle class="particle solid-p" cx="100" cy="240" r="14"/></g>
    <g class="v-3"><circle class="particle solid-p" cx="140" cy="240" r="14"/></g>
    <g class="v-1"><circle class="particle solid-p" cx="180" cy="240" r="14"/></g>

    <text x="120" y="360" class="sublabel" style="font-size: 13px;">Fixed shape & volume</text>
  </g>

  <!-- ================= LIQUID ================= -->
  <g transform="translate(330, 80)">
    <rect class="container-box" x="0" y="0" width="240" height="420" />
    <text x="120" y="40" class="label">Liquid</text>
    <text x="120" y="65" class="sublabel">Close, sliding past each other</text>
    
    <!-- Fluid cluster of 16 particles -->
    <g class="f-1"><circle class="particle liquid-p" cx="70" cy="130" r="14"/></g>
    <g class="f-2"><circle class="particle liquid-p" cx="110" cy="120" r="14"/></g>
    <g class="f-3"><circle class="particle liquid-p" cx="150" cy="135" r="14"/></g>
    <g class="f-1"><circle class="particle liquid-p" cx="180" cy="160" r="14"/></g>
    
    <g class="f-3"><circle class="particle liquid-p" cx="80" cy="170" r="14"/></g>
    <g class="f-1"><circle class="particle liquid-p" cx="120" cy="165" r="14"/></g>
    <g class="f-2"><circle class="particle liquid-p" cx="155" cy="185" r="14"/></g>
    <g class="f-3"><circle class="particle liquid-p" cx="65" cy="210" r="14"/></g>

    <g class="f-2"><circle class="particle liquid-p" cx="105" cy="205" r="14"/></g>
    <g class="f-3"><circle class="particle liquid-p" cx="140" cy="225" r="14"/></g>
    <g class="f-1"><circle class="particle liquid-p" cx="175" cy="215" r="14"/></g>
    <g class="f-2"><circle class="particle liquid-p" cx="90" cy="245" r="14"/></g>

    <g class="f-3"><circle class="particle liquid-p" cx="130" cy="260" r="14"/></g>
    <g class="f-1"><circle class="particle liquid-p" cx="165" cy="255" r="14"/></g>
    <g class="f-2"><circle class="particle liquid-p" cx="75" cy="280" r="14"/></g>
    <g class="f-1"><circle class="particle liquid-p" cx="115" cy="290" r="14"/></g>

    <text x="120" y="360" class="sublabel" style="font-size: 13px;">Takes shape of container</text>
  </g>

  <!-- ================= GAS ================= -->
  <g transform="translate(610, 80)">
    <rect class="container-box" x="0" y="0" width="240" height="420" />
    <text x="120" y="40" class="label">Gas</text>
    <text x="120" y="65" class="sublabel">Far apart, fast moving</text>
    
    <!-- Dispersed particles with motion trails -->
    <g class="g-1">
      <circle class="particle gas-p" cx="60" cy="130" r="14"/>
      <path d="M 45 120 L 30 110" stroke="#a5b4fc" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </g>
    
    <g class="g-2">
      <circle class="particle gas-p" cx="180" cy="110" r="14"/>
      <path d="M 195 100 L 210 90" stroke="#a5b4fc" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </g>

    <g class="g-3">
      <circle class="particle gas-p" cx="110" cy="160" r="14"/>
      <path d="M 100 145 L 90 130" stroke="#a5b4fc" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </g>

    <g class="g-2">
      <circle class="particle gas-p" cx="190" cy="210" r="14"/>
      <path d="M 205 215 L 220 220" stroke="#a5b4fc" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </g>

    <g class="g-1">
      <circle class="particle gas-p" cx="70" cy="220" r="14"/>
      <path d="M 55 225 L 40 230" stroke="#a5b4fc" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </g>

    <g class="g-3">
      <circle class="particle gas-p" cx="140" cy="270" r="14"/>
      <path d="M 145 285 L 150 300" stroke="#a5b4fc" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </g>

    <g class="g-2">
      <circle class="particle gas-p" cx="80" cy="330" r="14"/>
      <path d="M 70 345 L 60 360" stroke="#a5b4fc" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </g>

    <g class="g-1">
      <circle class="particle gas-p" cx="170" cy="340" r="14"/>
      <path d="M 185 350 L 200 360" stroke="#a5b4fc" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </g>

    <text x="120" y="360" class="sublabel" style="font-size: 13px;">Fills entire container</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Footer / Key takeaway -->
  <text x="450" y="550" class="sublabel" style="font-size: 15px; fill: #334155;">
    Adding thermal energy increases particle movement and spacing.
  </text>
</svg>
